request.spec: Let me put labels on projects so I can group them.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me put labels on projects so I can group them.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
You can now put labels (tags) on projects. They show as chips on the project page, and you can add or remove them there. `bin/e2e` passes the acceptance spec (1 test). The "create a new tag" form I added on top of what the spec covers has not been tested.

One note: the request mentioned an OfficeFloor server, but the app is actually Spring Boot (OfficeFloor is only in the package name). I built the server side with ordinary Spring code, as CLAUDE.md says to.

**Database:** `V13__project_tags.sql` adds two tables:
- `tag`: each tag has a unique name.
- `project_tag`: links projects to tags. If a project or tag is deleted, its links are deleted too.

**Server** (new `tag` package):
- `Project` now has a list of tags.
- `GET/POST /api/tags` lists all tags and creates new ones. Creating a tag whose name already exists, ignoring case, is refused.
- `GET /api/projects/{id}/tags` lists a project's tags. `PUT` and `DELETE` on `/api/projects/{id}/tags/{tagId}` add and remove one.
- Adding or removing a tag writes `PROJECT_TAGGED project=X tag=Y` or `PROJECT_UNTAGGED project=X tag=Y` to the audit log. Repeating an add or remove that's already been done does nothing and writes no record.
- The test reset and seed endpoints now clear and load tags and project tags.

**Front end:**
- A new `ProjectTags` component sits on the project page, above Tasks.
- Each tag shows as a chip (`project-tag-{id}`) with a remove button (`project-tag-remove-{id}`).
- To add a tag, you pick one from a dropdown (`project-tag-add`) and press Add (`project-tag-add-submit`). The dropdown only lists tags the project doesn't already have.
- The "New tag" form creates a tag and puts it on the project in one step.

The request mentioned grouping, but nothing yet filters or groups the projects list by tag. Tags only appear on each project's own page. Adding a tag column or filter to the projects list would be the natural next step.
